fact: Car 14 had several blue flags displayed prior to the car behind passing
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 e) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data and in-car video evidence. Although Car 14 received several blue flags before giving way for Car 5, the Stewards determine that Car 5 was neither trying to overtake, nor was it in close enough proximity to mandate Car 14 to move away immediately.
stewards: determine that Car 5 was neither trying to overtake
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 14 Alleged Ignoring Blue Flags
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
